summary: Ground explicit RFI Question and Response roles to the same exact workflow identity in project-file answers.
decision_refs: The active objective requires accurate file-grounded questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
An offline reproduction proved that the existing answer validator accepted Question and Response role swaps under the same RFI identifier
Reusing the existing exact workflow identity scoping avoids a second parser, dependency, model request or authority rule
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: The guard covers explicit Question and Response wording only; it does not infer a role from general prose or Request for Information wording.
Answer, Reply and Official Response normalize to Response only for citation consistency; the change does not infer contractual authority or chronology.
Response Date and Response Time do not establish that cited text is the RFI response, and a locator naming several workflow identities remains unscoped.
The change validates model-generated answers only and does not alter source parsing, workflow classification or deterministic status answers.
